comparison.objective: Lay a limp humanoid on its left side so it remains stable; candidate finishes four installed HELICOILs.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body articulated support, turning, and stable placement versus narrow-tool alignment, controlled striking, and tiny-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Humanoid remains on its left side on the pad versus four fractures and four contained tangs with no damage. Stability thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Articulated-body handling tests support and final stability, not fracture mechanics.
